newsitem.title: USA: Spectrum Oil sets financing, farm-in.
newsitem.headline: Spectrum Oil sets financing, farm-in.

text.p: Spectrum Oil Corp said Friday Ital Pak Marbles Ltd has tentatively agreed to make a $5 million investment in Spectrum and is discussing participation in the company's concessions in the Republic of Paraguay.

This would fund additional seismic work on the concessions, Chairman Robert Klein said, adding Ital is discussing commitment to a 10 well driling program on a farm-in basis once the seismic data has been evaluated.
Based in Islamabad, Pakistan, Ital is a diversified financial conglomerate with investments in mining, export, manufacturing and real estate, Spectrum said.
Under the terms of the a letter of intent, Ital has 45 days to review the company's technical data and due diligence both here and in Paraguay.
On successful completion of the review, Ital will purchase 1 million Spectrum shares for $5 each, the company said.
It now has about 11 million shares outstanding on a fully diluted basis, Klein said.

He commented "This joint venture will allow the company to complete its commitment to it's Paraguayan partners, Guarani Exploration and Development Corp and Expesa Petroleum Exploration SA. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
